title: Vapor-Chimney Acid-Sulfate / Phreatic-Vent Partitioning, Silica-Cation Boiling-Mixing Vector & Anisotropic Strike-Steered Subsurface Conduit Tensor
geological_mechanism: Boiling extensional/transtensional geothermal conduits exsolve buoyant H2S + CO2 + steam vertically through unsaturated fault breccia (forming explosion craters, native sulfur, sulfate crusts, argillic alteration, silicified breccias, and >175 C opaline sinter directly on blind fault intersections), whereas bicarbonate travertine precipitates 0.8-3.5 km down-hydraulic-gradient and pluvial tufa precipitates along ~1,330 m / ~1,555 m Pleistocene lake shorelines. Coupling 4-facies paleo-vent partitioning, quartz-chalcedony-cation solute boiling vs up-dip outflow mixing, 2-m probe conductive dT/dz + 1D Peclet concavity (2*T1.5m - T2m - T1m), and subsurface-strike-steered ridges of gravity slope (B05), magnetic curvature (B06), Euler upward-continuation index, GeoDAWN Efimov F-ratio + UK, cross-modal 1 m LiDAR B11 subsurface-strike locking, seismic dilatational work rate (B07, B08, B10, B16), and 10 m 3DEP drainage-branch piracy (sig_i32) isolates concealed and piedmont geothermal fault conduits missed by air-photo scarps.
named_non_fault_mimics: Pleistocene pluvial Lake Lahontan (~1,330 m) and Lake Bonneville (~1,555 m) wave-cut shoreline scarps and non-hydrothermal carbonate Tufa mounds (explicitly quarantined into vcaz_mimic_pluvial_tufa_shore; zero positive paleo weight on Tufa).

Unfaulted Neogene basalt/ash-flow tuff lava-flow margins and shallow boulder fans producing sharp surface magnetic gradients (tmi_hg, tc) that decay rapidly under 150 m upward continuation without basement gravity/depth steps (explicitly quarantined into vcaz_mimic_shallow_volc_edge).
